abilities.description: After assigning all your starting stats, add +1 to Heart, and -1 to Iron.
Educated: Whenever you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.13b2d777c6fb719d]{Gather Information} by studying, or by recollecting something from your previous studies, add +1.
Dark vision: Whenever making a move to see or maneuver in total darkness, add +2 due to your natural enhanced vision.

Atmospheric requirement: At all times, when you are not on your homeworld of Dorian, you must wear an antiox breath mask. Exposure to oxygen without your mask causes you 3 harm immediately, and if you cannot get a working breath mask on in a matter of minutes you must @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.0cfcd6fbaf6135d0]{Face Death}.
Extended stay in vacuum: You can remain in vacuum without harm up to five (5) minutes.
